title: The Demilitarized Transit
logline: A commercial logistics hauler carrying sealed naval sensor buoys across regional gates is ambushed by veteran privateers, exposing that the military cartel secretly seeded illegal peacetime surveillance arrays throughout demilitarized civilian corridors.

roles.description: A veteran commercial purser carrying sealed cargo across three systems; nervous, practical, and desperate to unload his freight before gate inspectors open it.
A cashiered privateer captain whose squadron was outlawed for protesting illegal naval listening posts in neutral transit corridors.
A ruthless administrative officer dispatched by the cartel to escort the illicit sensor hardware to a frontier scrap incinerator before a treaty commission arrives.
A nimble raider scout gunboat screening the privateer flotilla and tracking engine wakes through the gate lanes.
A heavily modified surplus gunboat with patched armor plates and overclocked prow cannons.
A cavernous logistics staging platform orbiting a crossroads star system.
A rust-streaked industrial smelting depot in an unpatrolled outer rim system.
A network of retired officers and private suppliers running covert security contracts along regional trade routes.

public_situation: A heavily laden freight hauler jumps across regional gates under armed escort, pursued by privateers claiming the shipment contains contraband military intelligence arrays.
private_truth: The containers hold illegal peacetime surveillance buoys covertly deployed in demilitarized space. The cartel is rushing them to a frontier smelter before a joint treaty inspection team arrives.

beats.public_change: A regional freight hauler docks at {role:provincial_depot} under emergency priority clearance, requesting heavy defensive escorts.

missions.reason: He hires an independent pilot to carry sealed manifest cylinders to the depot harbormaster before gate clearance expires, needing an outsider to avoid customs scrutiny.
missions.private_fact: The cargo cylinders are mislabeled as agricultural refrigeration pumps to bypass treaty registry scanners.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to purchase high-grade coolant canisters needed to keep the container cooling systems from cooking the hardware.
missions.private_fact: If the internal temperature spikes, the dormant listening arrays will reboot and broadcast registered naval encryption pings.

beats.public_change: The hauler jumps into the neighboring system, where corsair scouts immediately lock tractor beacons onto the ship's wake.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to intercept and destroy the trailing corsair scout picket before it relays the hauler's jump coordinates to the privateer wolfpack.
missions.private_fact: The scout hailed claiming the cargo contains surveillance gear that got his former naval squadron court-martialed.

beats.public_change: {role:fleet_auditor} arrives in system aboard an unmarked cutter, demanding custody of the cargo under wartime emergency clauses.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to scan the container seals at the scrap station to verify the surveillance transponder frequencies against demilitarization treaty logs.
missions.private_fact: He wants the listening posts proven real so the tribunal will overturn the treason convictions against his disbanded squadron.

beats.public_change: Cartel gunboats close in on {role:frontier_scrap_station} to burn the freight containers before the inspection commission enters the sector.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to clear the jump lane past the corsair cordon so the freighter can escape to the scrap incinerators.
missions.private_fact: {role:veteran_corsair} hails mid-fight offering a share of confiscated cartel escrow funds if the pilot helps force the freighter to dock with the privateers.

player_choice.prompt: With the fighting paused outside {role:frontier_scrap_station}, the pilot must decide whose hands receive the contraband surveillance arrays.

options.label: Deliver the cargo to {role:fleet_auditor} to incinerate the treaty evidence
Turn the freighter over to {role:veteran_corsair} to prove the squadron was framed
Broadcast the decrypted listening post coordinates across regional relays

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot allies with the corsairs and diverts the hauler to the privateers.
resolutions.summary: {role:veteran_corsair} captures the surveillance arrays and presents them to treaty inspectors. {role:fleet_auditor} flees while the privateers win pardons.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped cashiered privateers capture contraband military surveillance buoys before they could be smelted.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot defends the freighter and turns the cargo over to the fleet auditor.
resolutions.summary: {role:fleet_auditor} feeds the listening arrays into the smelter, destroying all proof of treaty violations. {role:veteran_corsair}'s squadron remains disgraced.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot escorted a contraband listening post convoy past privateers, destroying evidence of illegal peacetime spying.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot broadcasts the authentic listening post telemetry across regional networks.
resolutions.summary: The public learns {role:military_cartel} was spying on civilian corridors. {role:fleet_auditor} is arrested and trade routes open under international oversight.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broadcast telemetry proving the military cartel seeded civilian jump routes with illegal listening buoys.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot never intervenes or abandons the hauler.
resolutions.summary: Corsair gunboats overrun the freighter in unpatrolled space. {role:hauler_supercargo} is stranded while the uncalibrated sensor buoys are sold to border cartels.

loose_threads.detail: The shipping dockets include an indemnity bond issued by a private banking cartel with terms tied to treaty inspection indemnities.
The corsair frigate's hull displays a faint naval service crest identical to the one stamped on the listening array casings.

radio_hooks: Unscheduled military freight transit causes jump gate delays across three star systems.
Regional logistics board denies rumors of covert surveillance buoys recovered from shipping lanes.
Demilitarization treaty delegates demand inspection access to provincial transit hubs.

voice_direction.hauler_supercargo: Speaks in a rapid, defensive rattle, frequently checking manifests and muttering under his breath. Terrified of gate inspections.
voice_direction.veteran_corsair: Deep, gravelly, and deliberate, speaking with the cold formality of a court-martial officer. Never swears.
voice_direction.fleet_auditor: Chilly, immaculate, and speaks in chillingly calm bureaucratic circumlocutions. Never acknowledges a weapon is present.
